0022600215.text: The Orlando Magic (2-7, losers of four straight, 0-4 at home and 2-3 on the road) visit the Sacramento Kings (1-9, losers of three straight, 0-5 at home), with this being the Magic's 10th game of the season. Orlando is without Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain, 24.5 points per game this season), Jalen Suggs (knee, 8.0 points per game this season), Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), Jonathan Isaac (knee) and Noah Penda (hamstring strain), while Sacramento is missing Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery) and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee) and lists Domantas Sabonis (knee soreness) and Keegan Murray (wrist soreness) as day-to-day game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Orlando won the 2025-26 season series 2-0, including a 121-117 victory in Orlando on March 26, 2026.
